findings: Read PDF independently first and reached the same result. Candidate's 7 quotes all verified verbatim on the cited pages with correct printed-page mapping. Changes: (a) the candidate's pdf p210 quote is a mid-sentence fragment duplicating p209 and is replaced by the p209 quote; (b) candidate's other evidence (Yu Ailian, Jiaxing Jiaci rights) is negative context, not needed for the record. Link: Xiao is an officer (board chairperson) of the GP/manager of an identified Pre-IPO investor, which meets the reviewing standard; the name match is complete (full English and Chinese registered name identical on pdf p209 and p140), not merely a similar brand. Agree Yu Ailian (LP in employee platform only) and INEDs are not linked. No investor nomination/board/observer right is disclosed for any Pre-IPO investor (only info/MFN/divestment rights, terminated before listing application, pdf p138).
residual_uncertainty: Weakest of the three: prospectus does not say Heli nominated Xiao; he joined the board (June 2021) before Heli No. 7 acquired ~0.19% by equity transfer from Qianhai Tianzheng (April 2022); the prospectus calls Heli No. 7 an Independent Third Party without mentioning Xiao's role; Heli No. 7 is not among the Series A/B/B+ subscribers. Value 1 rests solely on the officer-of-GP link and would be unresolved under a stricter nomination-required reading.
